fact_card_packet.question: When is the announced roundtable, how can readers follow it, and what is its stated subject?

rows.label: Scheduled date
rows.support_excerpt: The Securities and Exchange Commission announced today that it will host a roundtable on November 9, 2026, to discuss the use of machine-understandable data and Super Intelligence (SI) and related risks and costs.

rows.value: The discussion will be streamed live on SEC.gov
